lines: Follow this page to get timely alerts on
Indian students pursuing PG degree abroad
A maximum of $1,20,000 and other benefits (one-time)

Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarships 2026 is a merit-based opportunity offered by the Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation (a non-profit organisation), to Indian students pursuing postgraduate studies at European, American, and UK universities abroad. The selected students will receive a maximum of $1,20,000 and orher benefits.
To be eligible, the applicants must:-
be an Indian passport holder who is residing in India at the time of application born on or after 1st January 1996
hold a first-class degree or equivalent from a recognised university/institution in India
Social Sciences, Humanities, Law, Fine Arts, Architecture, and related subjects: a minimum academic grade of 65%, CGPA 6.8/10, or GPA 2.6/4
Mathematics, Sciences, Environment, and related subjects: a minimum academic grade of 70%, CGPA 7.2/10, or GPA 2.8/4
hold an English language certification as a conditional part of their offer letter
have received a valid deferred offer letter for the academic year 2026-27
Candidates having a postgraduate qualification (e.g. Master’s or Ph.D.) from an institution abroad are not eligible to apply.
Candidates who are already studying or have started their postgraduate education at an institution abroad are not eligible to apply.
Applicants who hold an undergraduate degree from a recognised foreign university, with two years of continuous residence, employment, or study in India after graduation are eligible.
Selected students will receive a one-time support of $1,20,000 along with a travel allowance for a one-way ticket in addition to the tuition, maintenance, and health insurance.
The foundation will not provide any scholarships for visas, travel, and health insurance in isolation.
If the course costs more than the scholarship amount, applicants must demonstrate financial self-sufficiency for the remaining expenses at the time of application.
Academic transcripts, including degrees, certificates, marksheets, etc.
If the tuition fees are mentioned in the offer letter, then highlight the fee and upload the letter in the fee statement section as a PDF File format document.
If the tuition fee is not mentioned in the offer letter, then from the university website, download the tuition document, highlight the fees of the course, and upload it as a PDF file format.

Proof of additional funding such as personal bank statements/parent(s)/relative bank statements, and/or investment with a letter of authority/personal investment documents/approval letter of an educational loan, etc. (
If expired, continue to upload the old passport along with the receipt of the application made for a new one as one PDF file document.)
If the applicant has not received an admission/offer letter by 22nd March 2024, an acknowledgment of the application to the said University can be uploaded in a PDF file format.)
2 academic references (for students), and one professional one for those who are working (
The reference letter must be on a letterhead.)

The selection process consists of the following three stages:-
online preliminary interviews with candidates chosen from the review
a final in-person interview with those who succeed in the preliminary interview
Applicants will be assessed based on their past, and present achievements, and future potential.
Candidates applying for scholarships in art and design (fine/performing arts) will be primarily assessed on their portfolios.
The decision made by the Inlaks Selection Committee will be considered final.
Candidates who do not receive any communication from the Foundation by
must assume that their applications have not been successful.
Only one submission per candidate will be accepted.
Incomplete applications will not be accepted.
If the scholarship does not commence within nine months of award, it will be forfeited.
Students applying to specific universities may receive additional funding. These universities include:
The Royal College of Art (RCA) London
The foundation offers joint scholarships with these institutions, potentially exceeding the USD 1,20,000 limit, to eligible applicants.

Recipients of the Foundation's award may also pursue other funding sources, such as teaching assistantships or part-time jobs. However, they are required to inform the Foundation of any additional funding they are receiving.

Fieldwork in India during the program is not permitted for scholarship applicants, except for PhD students in Social Sciences, Public Policy, Arts & Humanities applying under the King's College London collaboration.
The foundation gives scholarships in a variety of subjects but DOES NOT fund the following courses:
Engineering (except Engineering and Natural Sciences at Imperial College, London)
Film and Film Animation (except Documentary filmmaking)
Question: Can Indian students apply for the Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarships?
Yes, Indian students are eligible to apply for this scheme.
Question: What are the academic qualifications for this scheme?
The applicants must be a graduate from university/institution in India and willing to pursue PG level studies.
Question: What are the awards for the Inlaks Shivdasani scholarship?
The selected students will receive a maximum of USD 1,20,000 and orher benefits.
Question: Is is mandatory to have a passport to apply for this scheme?
Yes, it is mandatory to have a passport when applying for the Inlaks Shivdasani scholarship.
